articles.title: Welcome to NewsFeed - Your Source for Latest News
articles.snippet: We're excited to launch NewsFeed, a simple and elegant platform for sharing the latest news and updates. This platform is designed to be easily automated with GitHub Copilot Agent.
articles.content:
We're thrilled to announce the launch of NewsFeed, your new destination for staying updated with the latest news and information.

What is NewsFeed?

NewsFeed is a simple, clean, and modern news platform built with GitHub Pages. Our goal is to provide a streamlined reading experience while making it easy to publish and manage news articles.

Key Features

Our platform offers several key features:

  • Clean, responsive design that works on all devices
  • Easy-to-read article snippets on the home page
  • Full article view with optimized reading experience
  • Automated news publishing capability

Designed for Automation

NewsFeed is specifically designed to work seamlessly with GitHub Copilot Agent for automated news publishing. The simple JSON-based data structure makes it easy to add new articles programmatically on a scheduled basis.

Stay tuned for more updates and news articles!
articles.author: NewsFeed Team

articles.title: How to Use NewsFeed Platform
articles.snippet: Learn how to navigate and use the NewsFeed platform effectively. This guide will help you get the most out of your reading experience.
articles.content:
NewsFeed is designed to be intuitive and easy to use. Here's everything you need to know to get started.

Browsing Articles

The home page displays all available news articles in a card-based layout. Each card shows:

  • Publication date
  • Article title
  • A brief snippet or summary
  • A 'Read More' link to view the full article

Reading Full Articles

Click on any article card to view the complete article. The article page includes the full title, publication date, author information, and the complete article content.

Navigation

Use the 'Back to Home' link on any article page to return to the main news feed. The platform is designed for seamless navigation and quick access to content.

Mobile Experience

NewsFeed is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices. Whether you're on a desktop, tablet, or smartphone, you'll enjoy the same great reading experience.
articles.author: NewsFeed Team

articles.title: Automated News Publishing with GitHub Copilot Agent
articles.snippet: Discover how NewsFeed integrates with GitHub Copilot Agent to enable automated news publishing on a scheduled basis.
articles.content:
One of the most powerful features of NewsFeed is its ability to work seamlessly with automated publishing systems.

The Power of Automation

NewsFeed uses a simple JSON-based data structure stored in the news-data.json file. This makes it incredibly easy to add new articles programmatically without manual intervention.

How It Works

GitHub Copilot Agent can be configured to fetch news from various sources and automatically update the news-data.json file. The process is straightforward:

  1. Agent fetches news from configured sources
  2. Formats the news into the required JSON structure
  3. Updates the news-data.json file
  4. Commits and pushes changes to the repository
  5. GitHub Pages automatically updates the website

Data Structure

Each article in the JSON file contains the following fields:

  • id: Unique identifier for the article
  • title: Article headline
  • snippet: Brief summary for the home page
  • content: Full article content (supports HTML)
  • date: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  • author: Article author (optional)
  • image: Article image URL (optional)

Benefits

This automated approach offers several advantages:

  • Consistent publishing schedule
  • No manual intervention required
  • Scalable to handle multiple news sources
  • Version-controlled content history
  • Easy to maintain and update
